limitations: The 1/2/8 concurrency levels and 5/49 named-principal cases were not run; this corpus isolates the already-reproduced four-way tail.
Hard user/global budget policies were disabled in this fixture and were not varied.

One supplemental persistent NVMe run was recorded as exploratory evidence only; SSD/NVMe is not required by M001. No controlled competing-I/O trial is available. Ambient host I/O was not controlled and varied during the MMC runs.
The original Q008 matrix emits p50/p95/max; the supplemental 1000-request run also emits p99, but no p99 acceptance threshold has been frozen.
tmpfs is a diagnostic control only and is not a durability recommendation.
